featureRecipe: 33 existing per-division past-form/Elo/history/league-interval features, 16 observed-statistic coverage fractions (5/15 games x home/away x shots-for/shots-against/SOT-for/SOT-against), three division indicators, three log base probabilities, one v1-available flag. No team or player ID embeddings and no injuries/news/weather/xG inputs.
baseline: Exact current Poisson v1 where eligible; otherwise historical within-division 1X2 frequencies. Always identify the fallback. This full-coverage study baseline is not a claim that deployed v1 predicts those missing-history fixtures.
architecture: One tanh hidden layer; logits = log(base probabilities) + neural correction; 963 trainable parameters for 56 inputs. Xavier hidden weights, fixed Gaussian hidden biases with std0.05, exactly zero initial output layer. Training-only weighted means/variances, constant scale1, feature clipping[-5,5].

optimizer.objective: weighted mean multiclass cross entropy + 0.5*l2*sum(all parameters squared)
optimizer.budgetStop: A finite iteration-limit stop is explicitly reported as not converged; nonfinite or abnormal line-search failures reject the fit. No validation-based epoch stopping.

trainingWeights: For each fold, exponential age decay relative to the fitting cutoff, then normalize each division's total training mass to one third. Fit preprocessing on exactly these weighted training rows only.
primaryMetric: Macro Log Loss: unweighted mean of the three division-specific Log Loss values, on all fixtures without drops
selectionRule: Fit once on2016-2022; choose one fixed probability blend (1-weight)*baseline + weight*neural on2023-2024 macro Log Loss. Exact ties prefer the smaller weight, including zero. Persist this choice before any audit or monitoring prediction metrics. No architecture, seed, prior or L2 search.
refitRule: After selection, refit the same architecture once on2016-2024 and freeze those weights for both2025 audit and2026 monitoring. These later labels must never enter that neural fit or its preprocessing. Match histories used as features still update strictly from past results.
finalFitRule: Only if selected weight is nonzero, a separate final model may refit all labels strictly before asOf minus one day. Its weights are not assessed by the saved historical metrics; future forecasts need a new registration and real observed outcomes. No automatic public promotion.
informationFence: Each feature/base pair uses only matches strictly before target date minus one calendar day, within its own division. The target result, target shots and all later matches are excluded. Training labels precede each fold's cutoff. Context-only2015 labels are never neural training examples.
metrics: Brier as mean sum of three class squared errors (0-2)
unique-top accuracy with ties and denominators
ten fixed calibration bins for each outcome
bootstrapMethod: Paired resampling of union UTC calendar-day clusters across all leagues; recompute each division mean inside each resample before averaging three means. Report null if any required division is absent, never substitute another period.
researchGate: Selected weight must be nonzero; macro Log Loss and macro Brier must improve against the baseline in BOTH later periods; no division's Log Loss may worsen in either later period; audit95% paired-day macro Log Loss interval must lie wholly below zero. Historical evidence only, never independent confirmation.
limitations: Every historical period has previously been inspected in other experiments; neural development does not make it an untouched independent test.
The source coverage is fixed: E0 ends2026-11-08, E1 ends2026-11-07, E2 ends2026-11-04. More recent results are not invented or silently joined.
Days since last same-league game are not total squad rest: cups, international duty and exact final-whistle publication timestamps are missing.
E2 starts2020. Early E2 features can have no history; flags and fallback frequencies are retained rather than dropping these fixtures or borrowing future seasons.
Smoothed feature priors are explicitly fixed pseudo-counts, not observed shots or measured xG. Coverage distinguishes missing values from observed zero.
Synthetic XOR and gradient tests validate implementation; they are not football performance results or architecture selection.
A richer model can overfit. An unchanged or worse later score means retaining the current model; do not retune on those later outcomes.
All original100, ELC36 and related future packets remain unchanged. No new daily neural job or extra paid provider is authorized by historical scores alone.
